name: ITPS309 Midterm Topic 6 - Forms & User Input Processing

questions.questionText: An interface for users to send data to the server.
Analogy: Think of a form like an ___ ______ _____ or a command-line prompt.
A form handles how data is __________, ___________, and ___________.
It ensures the right data reaches your database.
Forms ensure the ______ _____ reaches your database.

Django has a built-in library called _____________ that helps:
- Create HTML forms automatically
- Handle user-submitted data
- Validate data types and requirements

Think of it like:
A form builder that not only creates your forms but also checks your inputs for you.
2 types of forms in django.

- Built manually using forms.Form class.
- Define fields one by one.
- You manually decide how to handle the data afterwards.

Use Case: Great for simple forms that are not tied to a database (like a search form).

- Built using forms.ModelForm class.
- Connected directly to your database models.
- Django automatucally generates fields based no your model.

Use Case: Perfect for CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete).
It prevents malicious sites from submitting forms on behalf of a user.
Django escapes harmful HTML/JS code in user input. It prevents Cross-Site Scripting attacks.
Ensures users can't inject SQL commands through forms. Django ORM handles this automatically.

name: ITPS309 Midterm Topic 1 - Introduction to Web Systems

questions.questionText: A collection of tools, software, and services that enable dynamic websites and web applications.

3 example of web system.
- Online _______ system
- ____________ websites
- _______________ platforms
Components of a Web System.
A component of a web system of what the user sees.
A component of a web system with logic, database handling, and APIs.
A component of a web system stores data like user accounts.
2 web architecture.
Web architecture where everything is bundled together.
Web architecture where each service is independent.
It is a computing architecture where tasks are divided between providers (servers) and requesters (clients).
Client requests services or resources from servers, which then respond by providing the requested information or fulfilling request.
This model is widely used in various applications like web browsing, email, and online gaming.
